gate_distance_sensitivity.interpretation: Finite gate-perturbation scenarios; not a statistical confidence interval, measured current path, or whole-current length range.

gate_distance_sensitivity.rank_interpretation: Possible position by geographic gate separation within these seven source-gated spans; excludes along-current length and the published-length ranking. Overlap does not establish equal current length.
